policy: Only confirmed software workspaces/active work areas stay at H:\ top level. Root Excel/PPT stay in place. Tutorials, installers, licenses, work results/data, old backups, media, downloads and pending-delete candidates are organized into root-level category folders. No delete/copy/exec; only mkdir and move; delete candidates move to 07_待确认.
notes: Jason96, Petrel installation/license folders and all tutorials are intentionally NOT protected; they will be moved and renamed under root 02_专业软件.
license.lic will be moved to 02_专业软件\许可文件.
Y202 data folders and dq_liefengti data are not software workspaces; they go under 01_工作资料\专业数据.
Category folders themselves are not protected; the gate supports root-level destinations with -AllowRootStorage.
No delete/purge: delete candidates go to H:\07_待确认.
